svg.title: Listening live: from an endless stream to utterances to text
svg.desc: Top: the level in decibels of a 17 second recording containing four utterances separated by pauses, with the four detected segments shaded and labelled with the recognized words. Bottom: the endpoint detector's speech/silence state over time.
svg.text: Listening live: from an endless stream to utterances to text
LOUDNESS OF EVERY 10 MS BLOCK; SHADED: THE UTTERANCES THAT WERE CUT OUT, WITH THE RECOGNIZED TEXT
THE DETECTOR'S STATE: IT NOTICES THE END OF SPEECH 600 MS AFTER THE LAST LOUD BLOCK
